name: VLT_TRADER
summary: This EA places BuyStop and SellStop pending orders based on breakout signals from the iVLT custom indicator. When a signal is detected on a new bar, it sets pending orders at a configurable distance above the previous bar's high and below the previous bar's low, with optional stop-loss and take-profit levels. Existing pending orders are deleted once a position is opened to avoid duplicate entries.
summary_zh: 该EA基于iVLT自定义指标的突破信号，在前一K线的高低点上下方设置BuyStop和SellStop挂单。当新K线出现信号时，在可配置距离处挂单，并支持止损和止盈。持仓后自动删除未成交挂单，避免重复进场。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念是基于iVLT指标的突破信号，在前一K线高点上方和低点下方分别挂BuyStop和SellStop订单，属于典型的突破策略。入场条件为：iVLT指标第2个缓冲区在前一K线不返回EMPTY_VALUE时产生信号，且当前无持仓且无挂单时才设置新的挂单。出场条件完全依赖止损和止盈参数，EA本身不主动平仓，也缺少移动止损或信号反转平仓逻辑。仓位管理采用固定手数，SolveLots函数仅返回输入参数Lots，fLotsNormalize函数虽存在但未被调用，缺乏动态仓位调整能力。资金管理方面没有基于账户余额或风险比例的动态计算，固定手数可能导致不同账户规模下风险暴露不一致。挂单管理上，一旦持仓成功则删除所有未成交挂单，防止重复进场，这是较好的风控设计。但信号函数SignalOpenBuy/Sell/CloseBuy/CloseSell均为空实现，表明策略可能未完全开发或有冗余代码。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is a breakout system based on the iVLT custom indicator, placing BuyStop and SellStop pending orders above and below the previous bar's high and low respectively. Entry conditions require the iVLT indicator's buffer 2 to return a non-EMPTY_VALUE on the previous bar, combined with no existing position and no existing stop orders before placing new pending orders. Exit conditions rely entirely on fixed stop-loss and take-profit parameters with no trailing stop or signal-based exit logic, meaning the EA cannot adapt to changing market conditions after entry. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size input with no dynamic adjustment; the SolveLots function simply returns the input Lots parameter, and the fLotsNormalize function exists but is never called. Money management lacks any account-balance-based or risk-percentage-based calculation, so the same lot size applies regardless of account equity, creating inconsistent risk exposure across different account sizes. The pending order management is well-designed—when a position exists, all remaining stop orders are deleted to prevent duplicate entries. However, the SignalOpenBuy, SignalOpenSell, SignalCloseBuy, and SignalCloseSell functions are all empty stubs returning false, indicating either incomplete development or significant dead code.

parameters.name: PendingLevel
parameters.description: 挂单距离前K线高低点的点数
parameters.description_en: Pending order distance from previous bar high/low in points

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description: 止损点数，0表示不设止损

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description: 止盈点数，0表示不设止盈

pros: 挂单突破策略避免追价，在突破确认后自动进场，入场逻辑合理
持仓后自动删除未成交挂单，有效防止重复进场和过度持仓
止损止盈价格均经过规范化处理，并考虑了StopsLevel最小距离限制，减少订单被拒绝的概率
使用全局变量管理挂单状态，确保EA重启后能正确恢复交易逻辑
pros_en: Pending order breakout strategy avoids chasing price, entering only after breakout confirmation with sound entry logic
Automatic deletion of unfilled pending orders when a position exists prevents duplicate entries and overexposure
Stop-loss and take-profit prices are normalized and validated against StopsLevel minimum distance, reducing order rejection risk
Global variables manage pending order state, enabling proper recovery of trading logic after EA restart
cons: 缺少移动止损和信号反转平仓机制，仅依赖固定止损止盈，无法适应市场变化
SignalOpenBuy/Sell和SignalCloseBuy/Sell函数均为空实现，大量辅助函数（SolveBuySL/TP等）未被调用，存在大量冗余代码
固定手数无动态仓位管理，fLotsNormalize函数虽存在但未使用，不同账户规模下风险暴露不一致
无点差过滤，在高点差环境下挂单可能频繁触发后迅速止损
止损止盈比为1:1，缺乏盈亏比优化，突破策略通常需要更大的盈亏比才能长期盈利
cons_en: No trailing stop or signal-reversal exit mechanism—relying solely on fixed SL/TP cannot adapt to changing market conditions
SignalOpenBuy/Sell and SignalCloseBuy/Sell are empty stubs; many helper functions (SolveBuySL/TP etc.) are never called, indicating significant dead code
Fixed lot sizing with no dynamic position management; fLotsNormalize exists but is unused, causing inconsistent risk across different account sizes
No spread filter, so pending orders may be frequently triggered and quickly stopped out in high-spread environments
Stop-loss to take-profit ratio is 1:1 with no R:R optimization; breakout strategies typically require higher reward-to-risk ratios for long-term profitability
improvements: 实现动态仓位管理，基于账户余额和风险百分比计算手数，并启用fLotsNormalize函数进行规范化
添加移动止损和信号反转平仓逻辑，提高策略对市场变化的适应能力
增加点差过滤和盈亏比参数，避免高点差环境下的不利交易
improvements_en: Implement dynamic position sizing based on account balance and risk percentage, and activate the existing fLotsNormalize function for lot normalization
Add trailing stop and signal-reversal exit logic to improve the strategy's ability to adapt to changing market conditions
Add spread filtering and a configurable reward-to-risk ratio parameter to avoid unfavorable trades in high-spread environments

risk_points: 固定止损止盈比为1:1，突破策略在低盈亏比下长期期望值可能为负
无点差过滤，高点差环境下挂单容易被触发后快速止损
StopLoss为0时可不设止损，存在无限亏损风险
iVLT为自定义指标，策略表现高度依赖指标质量，指标不可用时EA无法运行
risk_points_en: Fixed 1:1 SL/TP ratio means breakout strategy may have negative long-term expectancy with low reward-to-risk
No spread filter exposes the EA to frequent stop-outs in high-spread environments
StopLoss=0 allows trading without stop-loss, creating unlimited loss risk
Strategy depends entirely on the iVLT custom indicator quality; if the indicator is unavailable, the EA cannot operate
